text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 1. Charging and data dock only (rev D: every number of the YAML cradle block). Printed body 60.0 x 60.0 x 14.0 mm (z -11.0 to 3.0); lip and latch stand above it,
overall height 22.63 mm. Frame: the marker frame with the marker seated (origin at the marker centre on its base plane); body from y -36.0 to 24.0.
2. The nest is the marker outline + 0.25 mm; the D flat is the key, so the marker seats one way round only. Its three ball feet rest on the front strip
and on two pads (z = -0.1); the rest of the floor is a basin that drains through the scallops. A rim round the pin slot and a dam in front of
the latch well keep water off the cradle PCB; the well drains through a tunnel (2.4 x 2.4) to the rear face beside the USB opening.
3. Hold-down: fixed lip over the top front edge (|x| <= 6.0, clear of windows, cover glass and vent) + sprung latch at the rear with a thumb tab.
The marker goes in nose first under the lip and is pressed down at the rear until the latch clicks. Details and numbers: sheet 2.
4. Cradle PCB top at z = -4.855: the spring pins stand at their working height (5.82) on the copper face of the pads (z 0.965). Seven pin
positions, consumer build fits four (VBUS, D-, D+, GND at x = -7.62 ... 0.0), factory fixture seven. Pin and receptacle envelopes are PROVISIONAL.
5. PRINT ORIENTATION LOCKED: the x axis of this drawing is the build direction (cradle_print.stl / .step), so that the profiles of latch and lip lie in
the build plane. No tumbling, no vapor smoothing. No wall below 0.8 mm, latch root 1.05 mm, no trapped powder (checks 5, 6).
6. First-article dimensions: front nest wall to hook nose 39.95 +-0.15; beam to stop ribs 1.3; tab-stop top z 6.57.
